summary: Zhengye Biotechnology Holding Ltd filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq minimum bid price deficiency notice on May 29, 2026, because its Class A ordinary shares closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days. The company has a 180-day compliance period through November 25, 2026, to regain compliance by having the bid price close at $1.00 or more for at least ten consecutive business days. If not cured, it may seek a second 180-day grace period and may effect a reverse stock split. No transaction, acquisition, or restructuring is involved; this is a routine listing standards notification.
